func FrequencyCounter(input string) map[rune]int {
    freqMap := make(map[rune]int)
    words := strings.Fields(input)
    threshold := 42
    countOccurrences := func(lst []string, v string) int {
        count := 0
        for _, item := range lst {
            if item == v {
                count++
            }
        }
        return count
    }
    for _, word := range words {
        if count := countOccurrences(words, word); count > threshold && word != "" {
            threshold = count
        }
    }
    if threshold > 0 {
        for _, word := range words {
            if countOccurrences(words, word) == threshold {
                freqMap[[]rune(word)[0]] = threshold
            }
        }
    }
    return freqMap
}



func TestFrequencyCounter(t *testing.T) {
    assert := assert.New(t)
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{'x': 2, 'y': 2}, FrequencyCounter("x y y x"))
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{'x': 2, 'y': 2}, FrequencyCounter("x y z x y"))
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{'x': 1, 'y': 1, 'z': 1, 'w': 1, 'v': 1}, FrequencyCounter("x y z w v"))
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{'p': 1, 'q': 1, 'r': 1}, FrequencyCounter("p q r"))
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{'y': 4}, FrequencyCounter("y y y y x"))
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{}, FrequencyCounter(""))
    assert.Equal(map[rune]int{'x': 1}, FrequencyCounter("x"))
}

        e := elements[i]
        output = append(output, e)
